# Error #97: WithdrawBatchTooLarge

<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-error-catalog.mjs. Do not edit manually. -->

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#97`
- **Variant Name**: `WithdrawBatchTooLarge`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`
- **Retryable**: `Yes`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::WithdrawManyTooLarge` — the batch withdraw exceeds MAX_WITHDRAW_BATCH stream ids.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::withdraw_many_bounds_the_batch_and_rejects_duplicates_upfront`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::withdraw_many_bounds_the_batch_and_rejects_duplicates_upfront). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// WithdrawManyTooLarge — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let mut ids = soroban_sdk::Vec::new(&f.env);
for id in 1u64..=(MAX_WITHDRAW_BATCH as u64 + 1) {
    ids.push_back(id);
}
Some(rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_withdraw_many(
    &f.recipient,
    &ids,
    &false
)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked withdraw_many_bounds_the_batch_and_rejects_duplicates_upfront
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Split the batch so it contains at most `MAX_WITHDRAW_BATCH` stream ids.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/CLAIM_ALL.md#1-overview--entrypoint-specification`](../../docs/CLAIM_ALL.md#1-overview--entrypoint-specification)
